## Flutter templates and generated files

Flutter copyright and BSD-3-Clause terms are reproduced in [LICENSES/Flutter-BSD-3-Clause.txt](LICENSES/Flutter-BSD-3-Clause.txt). The following scaffold and generated material originates from Flutter 3.47.2 (revision `d3b14c876900e553bc736ca19295fc09e3853e8e`), with Share Hub changes for desktop integration and separate app identity:

- Root `.gitignore`, `.metadata`, `analysis_options.yaml` and Flutter project configuration scaffolding.
- `windows/CMakeLists.txt`, `windows/flutter/**`, `windows/runner/**` excluding the project-authored application icon; `windows/.gitignore`.
- `macos/Flutter/**`, `macos/Runner.xcodeproj/**`, `macos/Runner.xcworkspace/**`, `macos/.gitignore`.
- `macos/Runner/AppDelegate.swift`, `MainFlutterWindow.swift` (template with substantial Share Hub channel integration), `Info.plist`, `Base.lproj/**`, `Configs/**`, and `*.entitlements`; `macos/RunnerTests/**` template scaffolding with project tests.

The independent `windows/platform/**`, `windows/tests/**`, `macos/Platform/**`, `macos/Runner/FileAccessBridge.swift`, Dart feature code and project tools are Share Hub-authored material under Apache-2.0. For template-derived files the upstream BSD notice continues to apply to the original portions; Share Hub modifications are provided under Apache-2.0. Preserve both notices when redistributing.

## Resolved dependencies and binary distribution

`pubspec.lock` records the package versions. Dependencies are resolved by Flutter and are not vendored source in this repository. Flutter and Dart runtime libraries, `crypto`, test tools and their transitive dependencies retain their respective licenses. The default open build does not depend on `flutter_webrtc`.

For binary releases, include the exact resolved Flutter/Dart and transitive dependency license notices (Flutter generates `NOTICES.Z` in the application assets). The source notices here are not a substitute for an inventory of all binaries in an eventual installer.

## Assets

The macOS app icons are project assets generated by `tool/generate_icon.swift`; the Windows icon was carried over from the same original client source tree. It is a project-specific icon, not the Flutter default icon. Its original conversion command was not tracked. Source provenance is recorded in [docs/source-origin.md](docs/source-origin.md); the icons are included within the project's Apache-2.0 asset scope. No permission to impersonate the official project is implied.
